items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Late, before Mount Allen died he had a, this fella he's dead now. John, I forget his name.

ctx.x: I was about the youngest. I was about the youngest.

in the band during that time. Do you remember who was playing baritone horn? Baritone horn? They had a fella called Frank. Frank Joseph, he was playing, he's dead now. Yeah, he was a cook, he used to cook on the clubs out there. He used to cook on what? He used to cook on one of those boats out there on the river. Oh yeah? Yeah. He was a little short fella. He had one of those upright bass. I mean a valet horn, yeah. Then finally after he passed away too. Late, before Mount Allen died he had a, this fella he's…
